https://www.newindianexpress.com/india/2.text: The Supreme Court on Monday directed the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) to use diplomatic channels to trace an Indian seafarer who went missing after the cargo ship he was aboard was struck by drones in the Black Sea on July 25.A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana asked Solicitor General Tushar Mehta to obtain instructions from the Indian Embassy in Ukraine and the Embassy of India in Bucharest, Romania, regarding the whereabouts of Deepak Kumar Gupta, a crew member of the cargo vessel MV AGN Ragnar. The matter has been listed for hearing on Friday.The court was hearing a petition filed by Sandeep Kumar Gupta, the missing sailor's elder brother, seeking directions to the MEA to coordinate with Indian diplomatic missions in Ukraine and Romania to intensify search and rescue efforts.According to the plea, the family approached the MEA and the Indian embassies in both countries between July 26 and July 30, but did not receive any response or assurance regarding the rescue efforts.Deepak Kumar Gupta, 22, went missing after the merchant vessel carrying Indian crew members came under a drone attack near Ukraine's Odesa port.The petition states that Gupta was serving as a crew member aboard the MV AGN Ragnar at the time of the attack. His family, originally from Siwan district in Bihar, has been living in Bharataul village in Uttar Pradesh's Bareilly district for several years..Follow The New Indian Express channel on WhatsApp Download the TNIE app to stay with us and follow the latest

Beállítom Miután három éve azt mondta, hogy benne vannak egy eladási folyamatban , aztán egy évvel később már „múló bolondériának” nevezte a cégeladást , Cserpes István eladta a Cserpes Sajtműhelyt. A vevő az ugyancsak sajtgyártással foglalkozó mosonmagyaróvári Profood Flexum Kft., egy szintén magyar cég, ami meg fogja tartani a márkanevet, Cserpes István pedig alapító tanácsadóként továbbra is aktív szerepet vállal a márka jövőjének alakításában. Korábban mi is megkerestük a Cserpest az üzlettel kapcsolatban, a mi értesüléseink azonban egy másik vásárlóra hivatkoztak, ezért megkeresésünkre a cég azt válaszolta, ezt nem tudják megerősíteni, és későbbre ígértek tájékoztatást. Ezután néhány órával ki is adtak róla egy hivatalos közleményt, amely szerint „hosszú, gondos szakmai és üzleti előkészítés után” egyesíti tudását és tapasztalatait a Cserpes és a Profood Flexum. Mint írták, a cél nem csupán egy tulajdonosváltás volt, hanem egy olyan hosszú távú működés kialakítása, amely biztosítja a Cserpes márka fejlődését, miközben megőrzi annak identitását, minőségét és a fogyasztók bizalmát. A megállapodás értelmében a Cserpes márkanév megmarad, és a jól ismert termékek, receptúrák, a munkatársak és az üzlethálózat is, Cserpes István pedig alapító tanácsadóként továbbra is aktív szerepet vállal a márka jövőjének alakításában. Az akvizícióval a Cserpes a Chepke márka mellé csatlakozik. Domokos Zsolt, a Profood Flexum vezérigazgatója azt mondta, céljuk, hogy megőrizzék mindazt, amit a fogyasztók a Cserpes névhez kötnek, miközben biztosítják a márka hosszú távú fejlődésének feltételei. „A Cserpes márka mindig a minőségről, a tisztességes munkáról és a fogyasztók bizalmáról szólt. Fontos volt számomra, hogy olyan partnernek adjam át a vállalatot, aki ezeket az értékeket nemcsak megérti, hanem tovább is viszi. Ezért vállalok a jövőben is aktív tanácsadói szerepet” – nyilatkozta Cserpes István. A felek a tranzakció pénzügyi részleteit üzleti megállapodásuknak megfelelően nem hozták nyilvánosságra. https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgy.text: Image source, Reuters Image caption, The border link between Ukraine and Moldova has been closed following an attack By Alicia Curry Published 4 hours ago Two people have been killed after Russian drones struck a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said. The Starokozache crossing, around 500km (310 miles) south of Kyiv, was closed after the overnight attack. Images from the scene showed several cars left completely scorched, with wreckage and debris strewn across the border post. Meanwhile, four people, including a child, were killed in the southern Russian city of Novorossiysk in a Ukrainian drone attack, the regional governor said. Both Russia and Ukraine have stepped up long-range strikes in recent months, despite renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war. Zelensky renewed calls for international support in the wake of the Starokozache crossing attack, saying "the aggression must be stopped here and now before it spreads any further". The border link between Ukraine and Moldova was shut after the attack killed two people and injured three others, Odesa regional governor Oleg Kiper said. A Moldovan driver was also injured, according to the country's foreign ministry. Moldova has increasingly found itself caught up in the conflict, with Prime Minister Vasile Tofan confirming that 17 drones had struck Moldovan territory in August alone - more than during the whole of last year. "Those who ignore or downplay these threats - and refuse to name the aggressor - are denying reality," he wrote on social media. "Russia started this war. Russia alone bears responsibility." Image source, Reuters Image caption, The Starokozache crossing is around 500km (310 miles) south of Kyiv Russia's defence ministry said its forces had shot down 596 Ukrainian drones overnight. Novorossiysk â in the south of the country on the Black Sea coast - was hit hardest in what governor Veniamin Kondratiev described as a "massive overnight enemy drone attack". As well as the four deaths, 29 people were injured, and damage was reported to residential buildings, a church and a preschool. The strikes came a day after Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke to US President Donald Trump by phone about efforts to end the conflict. The Trump administration has been pressing for direct talks between Russia and Ukraine, with Kyiv saying they could take place this month. The Kremlin, however, has said it is too early to discuss a date or venue. The call followed talks between US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff and Putin in Moscow, before the pair travelled to Kyiv for meetings with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
